definition.rate_selection: first measured safe rate in descending fixed schedule
definition.execution: train-with-autograd in every loss pass; identical no-update control before search
definition.rollback: restore parent before every trial; exceptions and exhaustion restore; experimental accepted step restored before exit
definition.scope: Prospective finite safeguard for one saved two-PC update on public training groups; not new held-out quality or a native learning cycle
definition.direction_preparation: Normalize each protected TRAIN gradient; bounded dual coordinate halfspace projection of saved two-PC direction
definition.reference_scope: Separate first-order task constraints from GEM equations 7-8; bounded local solver and different model/data, not a benchmark reproduction
definition.projection_failure: No finite-step search when returned representation violates a group constraint
definition.precision_conversion: Original public checkpoint tensors are BF16; exact FP32 conversion per linear, FP32 embedding output and small frozen parameters; no extra quantization
definition.backward_storage: Save original frozen BF16 matrices only; recompute temporary FP32 matrices during first-order backward
definition.memory_acceptance: Measure actual peak allocation in each physical GPU; no presumed laptop fit
